$comment: Hand-editable. `path` is where the column lands in the game object the three.js code reads (null = table-only metadata); an engine importing the CSV can ignore it. `required: false` + an empty cell = the field is absent.
description: One row per room type: size limits, how it grows, whether the front door opens into it, the floor finish, the loot table its containers roll, and what stands in it (RoomTypesFurniture: piece, min, max). RoomTypesVia lists the room types its doorway may open onto, best first. RoomTypesRare: a piece that appears by chance. `Fix`: exactly this wide along its split axis (a hall).

legacy.note: migrated from the JS literal; the equality test pins it

columns.name: Grow
columns.description: Share of the space left over once every room has its minimum.

columns.name: Back
columns.description: A back door may go in its outside wall (lower = preferred).

columns.name: Floor
columns.description: Hex colour of a floor finish laid over the building floor; empty = the building's own floor.

columns.name: Source
columns.description: Where the fact came from: a real source, a doc, or `design` (invented for the game).
